**Preferred Skills:**
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
* Any experience with CyberArk or other PAM solutions is beneficial but not required.
* Certifications such as CyberArk Defender or Sentry are desirable but not mandatory for entry\-level applicants


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

title: Service Executive
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a customer\-focused
 **Service Executive** 
 to act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for customers and dealers of the respective brand. The ideal candidate will manage end\-to\-end service communication product pickup/drop, case status updates, credit notes, and replacement/repair status while coordinating closely with service technicians to ensure priority repairs are handled on time. This role requires strong communication skills across email, phone (inbound/outbound), and CRM systems (Zoho).
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  





**Customer \& Dealer Communication (SPOC)** 



* Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for customers and dealers of the respective brand for all service\-related communication.
* Keep customers/dealers updated on product pickup and drop schedules and delivery status.
* Communicate case status updates, replacement/repair status, and resolution timelines clearly and proactively.
* Coordinate and communicate credit note status and processing updates to customers/dealers.
* Handle customer/dealer queries and concerns professionally, ensuring high satisfaction levels.



  





**Case \& System Management** 



* Update product pickup/drop, case status, credit notes, and replacement/repair status accurately and in a timely manner in the CRM system.
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all customer/dealer interactions in Zoho CRM.
* Track open cases end\-to\-end and ensure timely closure without delays.



  





**Coordination with Technicians** 



* Coordinate with service technicians for priority and escalated repairs to ensure timely turnaround.
* Follow up with the technical team on repair progress and relay accurate updates to customers/dealers.
* Flag delays or bottlenecks in repair status to the Service Manager for quick resolution.



  





**Calls \& Email Handling** 



* Handle inbound and outbound calls professionally, addressing customer/dealer queries and providing status updates.
* Manage email communication with customers and dealers, ensuring prompt and professional responses.
* Maintain clear, courteous, and solution\-oriented communication across all channels.

 Atlassian Platform Stewardship

 Regional SaaS \& MDM Escalation
   

  

  

* Regional Support: Act as the primary escalation path during local office hours for tools managed by the global team (including Slack, Google Workspace, Jamf, and Intune).
* Tier 2/3 Resolution: Resolve complex technical issues that standard IT support cannot handle, ensuring seamless operation for the local team before the global admins come online.


 ISO 27001 Compliance \& Audit
   

  

  

* Audit Readiness: Help prepare the IT environment for ISO 27001 audits by maintaining strict access controls and change management records.
* Evidence Collection: Be an active participant in audit interviews, providing "point\-in\-time" evidence such as access logs, termination of access reports, and proof of system patching.


**Background Sought**

* Cloud\-Based Business Platform Administration: Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, Microsoft365/Azure and Atlassian Org Administration.
* OS: Windows server, Linux.
* Networking Hardware: Fortinet, Ubiquiti.
* Identity \& Endpoint Management: OneLogin, Jamf, Intune, and A1\.
* Bonus points for experience with automation or APIs.
* Familiarity with at least one scripting language.


**General Requirements**
* Typically 2–5\+ years in systems administration or a similar operational role.
* Experience running audits/reports and presenting findings.
* Flexibility in working hours.
* Exhibits patience and resilience under pressure.
* Detail\-oriented and strong organizational skills.
* Strong verbal \& written communication skills.
* Self\-sufficient, proactive, and ready for a challenge.
* Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities.


**About Monks**
 Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.
   

  

 Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023\) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
